C&S Remodeling started in 2015 with Scott and Carol Kressner and remains family-owned and family-run. Scott's military and IT background brings practical planning to each project, while Carol's design experience keeps the finished space personal to the homeowner. Together, they lead a veteran-owned and woman-owned company built around thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship and a collaborative remodeling experience.

Design And Construction Under One Roof

The design and build sides of a remodel should work from the same plan. C&S handles design, 3D renderings, construction, plumbing, electrical work and finishing details as one connected team. That continuity helps the people building the project understand the choices made during design and gives homeowners one company to work with from the first ideas through the final walkthrough.

See The Plan Before Construction Begins

Every remodeling project includes complimentary 3D renderings. You can compare layouts, materials and key design choices while changes are still happening on screen. The rendering does not replace the detailed decisions that come later, but it gives everyone a shared visual reference before construction begins.

Founders Who Stay Connected To The Work

Scott and Carol are part of the company clients hire, not names detached from the project. Their different strengths shape the way C&S approaches a remodel: practical planning, considered design and close attention to how the finished space will be used every day.

Craftsmanship For Daily Life

A remodel has to do more than look good in photographs. Cabinet doors, tile layouts, lighting, storage and transitions between materials all affect how a room feels and functions. C&S pays attention to those details because homeowners will live with them long after construction is complete.

We recognize home renovation as an investment with the potential to transform your life. Getting it right is important to us, so we dedicate ourselves to understanding and applying your vision. Our San Antonio Home Remodeling Process

C&S keeps design and construction connected so each phase builds on the decisions made before it. The details vary by project, but homeowners can expect the work to move through four clear stages.

‍

1. Consultation And Project Goals

The first conversation is about the space, how it works today and what you want to change. We discuss priorities, style, function and the scope you have in mind. This gives the team a practical starting point before design choices begin.

‍

2. Design And 3D Renderings

The team develops the design and creates complimentary 3D renderings of the proposed space. The rendering makes it easier to compare layouts, materials and major features before construction begins. Adjustments can be explored while the project is still being planned.

‍

3. Construction By One Connected Team

Once the design is approved, C&S carries the plan into construction. The same design-build company coordinates the work across carpentry, plumbing, electrical and finish details, keeping the visual plan and the physical build connected.

‍

4. Final Walkthrough

At the end of the project, the team walks through the completed space with you and reviews the finished work. The goal is a home that reflects the approved design and works for the way you planned to use it.

At C&S Remodeling, we turn outdated bathrooms into stylish, functional spaces that add comfort and value to your home. Our experienced contractors handle everything from design to installation, ensuring a seamless remodeling experience. Bathroom Remodeling Solutions For Every San Antonio Home

We handle every kind of bathroom project, from a tight powder room refresh to a full master suite overhaul.

Master Bathroom Remodels


Your master bathroom should be the most comfortable room in your house. Our master bath remodels often include walk-in showers with multiple shower heads, freestanding soaking tubs, dual vanities with plenty of storage, and heated flooring. We build these spaces to feel relaxing and put-together; they still need to work for busy San Antonio families.

Powder Room Upgrades


A powder room is the perfect place to take a design risk. The small footprint lets you go bolder than you might in a larger room: a striking wallpaper, a statement light fixture, or a standout pedestal sink. Our designers know how to pack style and function into a tight space.

Guest Bathroom Renovations


Your guest bathroom sets the tone when company comes over, so it should hold up as well as it looks. We build guest bathrooms that pair durable materials with smart design: vessel sinks, easy-clean tile, and quality fixtures picked to look sharp and handle daily wear.

Hall Bathroom Transformations


A shared family bathroom has to handle a lot: different schedules, different needs, and heavy daily use. We design hall bathrooms with practical storage, durable materials, and layouts that actually work for everyone in the house.

Why Choose C&S Remodeling For Your Bathroom Renovation In San Antonio?

Founders Scott and Carol Kressner built C&S Remodeling around a simple idea: one team should carry your bathroom remodel from first sketch to final walkthrough. As a veteran owned, woman owned, family run company, we bring military precision and genuine design expertise to every project.

What that means for your remodel: a true design build process with design, construction, plumbing, and electrical handled in house, a complimentary 3D rendering of your new bathroom before work begins, and honest guidance on materials and trade-offs, even when the honest answer is the less expensive one. You will know exactly what your project costs and who is accountable for it at every step.

Remodeling Your Bathroom's Core Features
Bathroom Vanities

C&S Remodeling offers expert bathroom vanity services designed to enhance your bathroom's functionality and aesthetic appeal. We provide a wide range of contemporary and traditional vanity styles, ensuring that each project perfectly complements the overall design of your space. Our design team will work closely with you to tailor each aspect of the vanity to your preferences. You have full control over elements like the counter's size and material, the number of sinks, and the amount of storage space.

Custom Cabinetry

C&S Remodeling specializes in custom cabinetry that maximizes storage and adds a touch of elegance to your bathroom. Our skilled team designs and builds cabinets that fit your unique space and style preferences. From classic wood finishes to sleek modern designs, we offer a variety of cabinetry options. Our professionals meticulously craft each cabinet to provide optimal functionality and long-lasting beauty. With our custom cabinetry services, you can create a clutter-free and organized bathroom that reflects your personal style.

Bathroom Tilework

C&S Remodeling provides professional bathroom tilework services that transform your bathroom into a stunning and functional space. Our experienced tile installers have the skill to implement intricate wall and floor tiling designs. We offer various tile materials, such as ceramic, porcelain and natural stone, to create durable and visually appealing surfaces. Our rigorous attention to detail ensures uniform tile positioning, sturdy placement and beautiful grout lines. You can expect a flawless finish that adds value to your home.

Bathtub & Shower Remodel

C&S Remodeling can incorporate a luxurious bathtub and shower assembly into the remodeling plans. Our design expertise and material selection allow us to create extravagant tubs, showers and tub-to-showers, that provide a luxurious bathing experience. We cater to your needs and preferences by offering custom walk-in showers, freestanding tubs and combined bathtub-shower units. Using high-quality materials and modern design techniques.

Our shower and tub remodeling team uses premium materials and design techniques to blend aesthetic appeal and luxury with functionality and durability. With the ability to handle plumbing, waterproofing, tiling and fixture installation, we streamline the tub and shower remodeling process.

We guide you from concept to completion. Our design consultations, bathroom remodel cost guide, and construction expertise help bring your dream bathroom to reality.

Masterful Craftsmanship

Your Bathroom Remodeling Timeline

Knowing what to expect during your bathroom remodel makes the whole process easier to plan around. Here's a typical timeline for a mid-range bathroom renovation in San Antonio.

Week 1: Demolition & Preparation

We remove existing fixtures, tile, and anything being replaced. This phase also includes inspecting the plumbing and electrical systems for needed updates and prepping the space for new installations.

Week 2: Rough-In Work

Our licensed professionals handle plumbing relocations, electrical updates, and any structural changes. You won't see this work in the finished bathroom, but it's what makes everything else hold up.

Week 3: Installation Begins

This is when the project starts looking like a bathroom again. We install backer board, waterproofing membranes, and begin tile work. Your new vanity, toilet, and fixtures are staged and ready for installation.

Week 4: Finishing Touches

Final installations include lighting, mirrors, hardware, and paint. We run a full quality check and walk you through every detail of your new bathroom before we call it done.

Note: Timelines vary based on project complexity. Your project manager will provide a detailed schedule during the planning phase.

What Does Bathroom Remodeling Cost In San Antonio?

Every bathroom remodel is different, so we like to be upfront about what things cost. Here's what San Antonio homeowners typically invest based on project scope:

‍

Budget-Friendly Updates: $8,000 - $15,000

Good for refreshing an outdated bathroom without major structural changes. This range typically covers a new vanity, toilet, lighting fixtures, fresh paint, and updated hardware. Works well for guest bathrooms or when the existing layout is already solid.

Custom Bathroom Cabinets In San Antonio

Enhance your home’s functionality and style with quality cabinetry from C&S Remodeling. Our San Antonio bathroom remodel team designs and builds cabinets that fit your needs and aesthetic preferences. Contact us to get started on your bathroom cabinetry today!

CONTACT US
Bathroom Cabinet Installation Services

Your bathroom cabinets set the tone for the entire room. They shape how the space works every morning, how it looks when guests visit, and how much value it adds to your home. At C&S Remodeling, we design and install custom bathroom cabinets in San Antonio that pair lasting craftsmanship with style you'll actually want to live with.

Our design-build approach means your bathroom cabinets are handled entirely in-house. First consultation through construction, finishing, and final installation. There's no outsourcing and no miscommunication between teams. Scott brings military-trained precision to every measurement and project timeline, while Carol works directly with you on the design, whether that's a clean modern vanity, warm traditional wood cabinetry, or something uniquely your own.

Every set of bathroom cabinets we build starts with a thorough assessment of your space. We measure the room, check your plumbing and electrical layout, and talk through how you actually use the bathroom day to day. That conversation shapes every decision: cabinet depth, drawer configuration, hardware selection, finish. The cabinetry fits your bathroom perfectly and works exactly the way you need it to.

We serve homeowners throughout San Antonio and the surrounding Hill Country, including Alamo Heights, Boerne, Bulverde, and Shavano Park. Powder room update, guest bathroom renovation, full primary suite transformation — our team builds bathroom cabinets that last.

Bathroom Cabinet Styles We Build

Cabinet style has a bigger impact on your bathroom than most people expect. C&S Remodeling builds bathroom cabinets in every major style, and we customize each one to fit your space.

Shaker Cabinets


The most popular choice for San Antonio bathroom remodels. Clean lines, a recessed center panel, and a versatile look that works in modern and traditional bathrooms alike. We build Shaker cabinets in every finish from bright white to deep espresso.

Raised-Panel Cabinets


A classic. The center section sits above the frame, creating subtle shadow lines that give the room a traditional, refined feel. These work well with ornate hardware and warmer wood tones.

Glass-front cabinets let you display folded towels, decorative items, or accessories behind tempered glass panels set into wood frames. We can add interior lighting for a showroom-quality finish.

Flat-Panel (Slab) Cabinets


Create a smooth, uninterrupted surface that pairs well with minimalist hardware and floating vanities. If you're going for a sleek, contemporary bathroom, these are the doors to consider. Especially popular in modern primary suites.

Open Shelving Combinations


Some homeowners in San Antonio prefer mixing closed cabinetry with open shelving. This gives you hidden storage for everyday items alongside display space for decorative touches. It works particularly well in smaller guest bathrooms where a full run of cabinets would feel heavy.

The Benefits Of Our Bathroom Cabinets
Built To Fit Your Bathroom Exactly

Every bathroom has its own dimensions, plumbing layout, and quirks. Prefabricated cabinets from big-box stores force you to work around standard sizes that rarely match your space. C&S Remodeling builds bathroom cabinets designed specifically for your room.

We measure every wall, corner, and obstruction before building begins. If your bathroom has an awkward alcove, an off-center window, or plumbing lines that limit where a vanity can go, we design around those constraints instead of ignoring them. The cabinetry uses every available inch without crowding the room or blocking access to fixtures.

This matters most in older San Antonio homes, where bathroom layouts weren't built with modern storage needs in mind. We routinely build cabinets for bathrooms with non-standard ceiling heights, sloped walls, and tight clearances around doors or shower enclosures. Your bathroom cabinets should fit like they were always meant to be there. That's what we deliver.

Smart Storage Solutions For Every Bathroom

A well-designed bathroom cabinet does more than hold towels. It turns a cluttered countertop into an organized space where everything has a place. C&S Remodeling designs bathroom storage solutions that match how you actually use the room.

‍

Drawer Inserts and Dividers — Custom dividers inside your vanity drawers keep hair tools, grooming supplies, and daily essentials separated and easy to find. No more digging through a jumbled drawer every morning.

‍

Built-In Hamper Compartments let you tuck a pull-out laundry hamper directly into your bathroom cabinetry. Hidden behind a cabinet door, it slides out when you need it and keeps dirty linens out of sight without eating up floor space.

‍

Adjustable Interior Shelving — Our cabinets include adjustable shelves you can reconfigure as your needs change. Tall bottles, short containers, stacked towels; you decide how the space works.

‍

The area beneath your bathroom sink is often wasted space. We design custom pull-out trays and tiered shelving that work around your plumbing lines, turning that dead zone into usable storage.

‍

Linen Tower Cabinets — For bigger bathrooms, we build floor-to-ceiling linen towers for towels, sheets, and bathroom supplies. These tall cabinets double as a visual statement while solving the age-old problem of where to keep extra linens.

‍

Craftsmanship That Lasts

Bathroom cabinets face daily exposure to humidity, temperature swings, and constant use. Cheap cabinets warp, peel, and fall apart within a few years. C&S Remodeling builds bathroom cabinets with construction methods and materials that hold up to real bathroom conditions in San Antonio.

‍

Every cabinet we build uses dovetail or mortise-and-tenon joinery at stress points. Not staples or glue alone. Drawer boxes are constructed with solid wood or high-grade plywood bottoms that resist sagging even when fully loaded. We apply moisture-resistant finishes and sealants formulated for high-humidity environments, so your cabinetry looks as good in year ten as it does on installation day.

‍

Our finishing process: multiple coats of paint or stain, hand-sanded between applications for a smooth, even surface. Hardware gets mounted with reinforced backing so handles and pulls stay tight over thousands of uses. These details separate custom-built bathroom cabinets from mass-produced alternatives. They're the reason our clients consistently tell us their cabinets exceeded expectations.

Endless Design Possibilities

With C&S Remodeling, you gain endless design possibilities for your bathroom cabinets. Whether your style leans toward modern minimalism, classic elegance, or rustic charm, we offer a wide range of materials, finishes, and hardware options for your cabinets. Our design team works closely with you to understand your aesthetic preferences and functional needs, creating cabinets that perfectly complement your bathroom's décor. This flexibility means you get a cohesive, personalized space that reflects your taste.

Materials And Finishes For San Antonio Bathroom Cabinets

The materials you choose for your bathroom cabinets affect everything from durability to aesthetics to long-term maintenance. C&S Remodeling works with a full range of cabinet-grade materials and finishes so you get the look and performance you need.

‍

Cabinet hardware ties your bathroom design together. We source knobs, pulls, and handles in brushed nickel, matte black, polished chrome, brushed gold, and oil-rubbed bronze. Our design team will help you pick hardware that complements your faucets, lighting, and other fixtures.

‍

Solid Hardwoods — Oak, maple, cherry, and birch are our most-requested woods for bathroom cabinetry. Each species has its own grain pattern, hardness, and staining characteristics. Maple takes paint beautifully for a smooth, uniform finish. Oak shows a visible grain that adds warmth and character. Cherry darkens naturally over time for a rich, evolving appearance.

‍

Stained Finishes — Natural wood stains let the grain show through while adding depth and richness. We offer stains from light natural tones through medium walnut to deep espresso. Every stained cabinet gets a clear protective topcoat for moisture resistance.

‍

Engineered Wood and Plywood — If you want strong moisture resistance at a lower price point, we build cabinet boxes from furniture-grade plywood with hardwood veneer faces. Plywood resists warping and swelling better than solid wood in humid San Antonio bathrooms, which makes it a smart practical choice.

‍

Painted finishes are straightforward: white and off-white remain the most popular for bathroom cabinets in San Antonio, but we paint in any color. Our multi-coat process includes primer, paint, and a protective topcoat that resists chipping, yellowing, and moisture damage. Matte, satin, and semi-gloss sheens are all available.

What Cabinet Materials Work Best In Humid Bathroom Environments?

Plywood cabinet boxes with hardwood veneer faces offer the best moisture resistance for San Antonio bathrooms. Solid hardwoods like maple and birch also hold up well when properly sealed. We apply protective topcoats on every cabinet we build to guard against humidity, water splashes, and temperature swings.

Types Of Bathtub Installations
Alcove Bathtubs

Alcove bathtubs are installed in a three-walled enclosure and are ideal for maximizing space in small bathrooms. You can also gain a shower and tub in one with this design and our bathtub remodeling services.

Freestanding Bathtubs

Stand-alone tubs can be placed anywhere in the bathroom, offering a luxurious and modern look. These options come in varying shapes and sizes to give you a design that suits your style and needs.

Drop-In Bathtubs

These tubs are installed into a prebuilt deck or platform, providing a seamless and customizable design. You can make your bathroom feel more open by installing this feature, and it offers a built-in space to store your toiletries and towels.

Curbless (Zero-Threshold) Showers

Designed to fit into a corner, these tubs are perfect for saving space while adding a unique element to the bathroom. These tubs also create a seating area and may enable storage along the sides.

Walk-In Bathtubs

These bathtubs have a door for easy entry, offering convenience and safety, especially for those with mobility issues. Many also have seats, hydrotherapy options, nonslip surfaces, and grab bars.

Clawfoot Bathtubs

Classic tubs with decorative feet add an elegant and vintage touch to the bathroom. When installing this tub, you gain greater versatility in placement and can even put one in the middle of your floor.

Jetted Bathtubs

Equipped with jets for hydrotherapy, these tubs deliver a spa-like experience at home. They're an excellent option for homeowners seeking increased relaxation or relief from chronic health conditions.

Soaking Bathtubs

These baths are deeper than standard tubs and designed for a full-body soak and relaxation. Avoid your knees sticking out of the water, creating a more comfortable bathing experience at home.

CONTACT US
Types Of Shower Installations
Walk-In Showers

Featuring a frameless design, these showers provide easy access and a modern, open feel, ideal for small and large bathrooms. You can customize the size to suit your space and gain an easy-to-clean area with fewer nooks to scrub.

Corner Showers

Installed in the corner of the bathroom, these showers save space and can come in various shapes, such as triangular or neo-angle designs. They can make your bathroom look bigger and fit in any corner.

Shower-Tub Combos

Combining a bathtub and a shower in one unit, this installation is perfect for maximizing functionality in limited spaces. These designs can also bring unique beauty to your home, especially when you work with a professional bathtub remodeling company.

Corner Bathtubs

Also known as barrier-free showers, these installations eliminate the step into the shower, offering a seamless transition that is both stylish and accessible. Our team can create a beautiful design with the customized drainage necessary to keep the rest of your bathroom dry.

Steam Showers

Equipped with steam generators, these showers provide a spa-like experience with the added benefits of steam for relaxation and health. If you want this feature in your bathroom, we can integrate and install it seamlessly into the design.

Glass-Enclosed Showers

Featuring clear or frosted glass doors and panels, these showers create a sleek, contemporary look while maintaining a sense of openness. These installations have many customization options to suit your vision.

Custom Tile Showers

Designed and built to your specifications, custom tile showers offer endless design possibilities and a personalized touch to your bathroom. Shape your shower to suit you with options like niches or shelves for toiletries and a footrest for shaving.

Spa Showers

Incorporating multiple shower heads, body jets, and advanced controls, spa showers offer a luxurious and therapeutic experience right in your home. Experience showering in a new way with customized solutions from C&S Remodeling.

How Your Shower or Tub Remodel Works

‍

1. Free Consultation & 3D Design Preview

We start with a walkthrough of your bathroom to understand what's working and what isn't. You tell us what you're after: a tub-to-shower conversion, accessibility upgrades, a full overhaul. Before any work begins, we create a 3D rendering so you can see exactly what your new bathroom will look like.

‍

2. Material Selection

Choose from tile, fixtures, glass enclosures, and hardware that fit your style and budget. We guide you through options and handle sourcing so nothing falls through the cracks.

‍

3. Demo & Build

Our crew handles demolition, plumbing modifications, waterproofing, tile work, and fixture installation. We keep you updated throughout and stay on schedule.

‍

4. Final Walkthrough

Once the work is done, we walk through the finished space together. If anything isn't right, we address it before we call the project complete.

‍

Accessible Shower Options For San Antonio Homeowners

Traditional bathtubs can become difficult to use as mobility changes. We build shower and tub solutions that put safety first without looking clinical. Clean designs, practical features, built in from the start.

Curbless Showers

A curbless (zero-threshold) shower removes the step-over barrier entirely. The floor flows straight into the shower with no lip or ledge, so it works for wheelchair access, walkers, or anyone who wants a more open layout. It also makes the bathroom feel larger.

‍

Built-In Safety Features

Safety features should match the rest of the bathroom, not look bolted on:

 
Grab bars in finishes that coordinate with your fixtures
 
Built-in shower benches in tile or stone, not plastic
 
Non-slip tile flooring rated for wet surfaces
 
Handheld shower heads on adjustable slide bars
 
Lever-style handles instead of knobs

‍

Future-Proofing During Your Remodel

Even if accessibility isn't a concern today, adding blocking behind the walls during your remodel costs almost nothing. It means grab bars or a bench can be added later without tearing into tile. We recommend this for every project.

Should You Keep Your Tub Or Switch To A Shower?

This is the most common question we hear during consultations. The answer depends on your household, your home's layout, and how you actually use the bathroom.

Keep The Tub If:

 
You have young kids who take baths regularly
This is the only full bathroom in your home
You're planning to sell within 5 years (buyers expect at least one tub
You use the tub for soaking or relaxation

‍

Convert To A Shower If:

You have another tub elsewhere in the house
The tub hasn't been used in months (or years)
You want more usable floor space
Mobility or accessibility matters now or will soon
You prefer the look and feel of a walk-in shower

Project costs depend on scope, materials, and layout changes. These are realistic ranges based on what San Antonio homeowners typically spend:

‍

Tub-to-Shower Conversion: $5,000–$15,000

Removing an existing tub and installing a walk-in shower in the same footprint. Includes plumbing modifications, new shower pan, tile surround, glass door or curtain rod, and fixtures. Tile selection and door style are the biggest cost variables.

‍

Custom Walk-In Shower: $8,000–$25,000

A ground-up shower build with features like multiple shower heads, built-in niches, bench seating, and frameless glass enclosure. Premium tile and upgraded fixtures push the number higher; most of our custom projects land in the $12K–$18K range.

‍

Freestanding Tub Installation: $3,000–$12,000

A standalone tub placed in open floor space. Cost depends on tub material (acrylic vs. cast iron), plumbing work needed, and whether you're adding a floor-mounted faucet.

‍

Tub/Shower Combo Refresh: $6,000–$18,000

Replacing an existing tub-shower unit with a new tub, updated tile surround, and modern fixtures. Good option if you want to keep a tub but update the look.

‍

Every project starts with a free consultation and a detailed estimate. No surprises.

How Long Does A Tub-To-Shower Conversion Take?


Most conversions take 5–10 business days. A straightforward swap in an existing alcove is on the shorter end. Custom tile work, layout changes, or accessibility features add time.

Will Removing My Only Tub Hurt Resale Value?


If you have at least one other tub in the house, converting to a shower usually helps resale value. Walk-in showers are one of the most requested features in San Antonio. If this is your only tub, we'd recommend keeping it or exploring a combo option.

Do You Handle The Plumbing, Or Do I Need A Separate Plumber?


We handle everything in-house: plumbing, waterproofing, tile, glass, and fixtures. One team, one point of contact.

What's Included In The Waterproofing?


Every shower we build gets a full waterproofing membrane behind the tile. San Antonio's humidity makes this non-negotiable. We also use proper slope on the shower pan and seal all penetrations to prevent leaks.

Can I See What My New Shower Will Look Like Before Construction Starts?


Yes. We create a 3D rendering of your new bathroom during the design phase. You'll see the layout, materials, and finishes before we touch anything.

What's The Difference Between Framed And Frameless Shower Doors?


Framed doors have metal around each glass panel and tend to cost less. Frameless doors use thicker glass with minimal hardware for a cleaner, more modern look. We install both; your bathroom layout and budget will point you in the right direction.

Do You Offer Financing?


Yes. We offer financing options to help spread the cost of your remodel. Ask about current terms during your consultation.

Bathroom Tile Installation In San Antonio, TX

Bathroom tile installation is the single biggest visual upgrade you can make to a San Antonio bathroom. The right tile turns an ordinary space into one that feels custom-built, with surfaces that hold up to daily moisture, foot traffic, and years of wear. We handle every phase of your bathroom tile installation under one roof. Full shower retiles, new bathroom floors, decorative backsplashes: our team delivers careful craftsmanship across San Antonio, Alamo Heights, Boerne, and the surrounding Hill Country communities.

VIEW BATHROOM COST GUIDE
Professional Bathroom Tile Installation

Our bathroom tile installation team works with a full range of premium materials: ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, marble, glass, and mosaics. Each one brings different strengths to your bathroom, and we'll help you figure out which option fits your design goals, budget, and the specific demands of your space. A guest bath with light foot traffic has different needs than a primary suite shower that runs twice a day. We factor those details into every recommendation.

C&S Remodeling is a true design-build company, which means you work with one team from start to finish. There's no handing off your project between a designer, a general contractor, and a tile subcontractor. Our installers understand the design intent because they were part of the planning conversation. That single-team approach cuts out miscommunication and produces tighter results; patterns align correctly and grout lines run straight across the full width of a wall.

Before any tile is set, we provide complimentary 3D renderings so you can see your finished bathroom with your actual tile selections. This step prevents costly mid-project changes and takes the guesswork out of the final look.

Bathroom Tile Materials

The tile material you pick shapes everything about your bathroom remodel: how it looks, how long it lasts, and how much work it takes to keep clean. Our San Antonio bathroom tile installation team works with every major tile type and helps you choose the one that fits both your vision and your daily life.

Ceramic Tile

Balances affordability with design flexibility, which is why it remains a go-to for bathroom tile installation. You'll find ceramic in virtually unlimited colors, patterns, and sizes, and it resists stains and scratches well in moderate-use areas. It's also lighter than porcelain, making it a strong option for wall applications and backsplashes where weight matters.

Porcelain Tile

Is denser and less porous than ceramic. That lower porosity — less than 0.5 percent water absorption — makes porcelain the top pick for high-moisture areas like shower floors and tub surrounds. It won't crack in temperature swings and holds up to heavy daily use with almost no upkeep. We recommend porcelain often for San Antonio families who want a set-it-and-forget-it surface.

Natural Stone Tile

Marble, travertine, slate, granite — brings texture and color variation that manufactured materials can't match. Each slab is different, which gives master bathrooms and spa-style spaces a one-of-a-kind feel. Stone is porous, so our team applies professional-grade sealant during installation to protect against moisture and staining. We'll also walk you through the re-sealing schedule for your specific stone type.

Glass Tile

Reflects light and adds depth to smaller bathrooms, which makes the space feel larger and more open. Glass is non-porous, stain-proof, and naturally resistant to mold, so it works well in shower niches, accent bands, and backsplashes. Our installers use specialized adhesives and techniques for glass tile to keep the adhesive from showing through translucent surfaces.

Mosaic Tile

Opens up design possibilities that larger tiles can't deliver: detailed patterns, custom layouts, and artistic accents. Mosaics work well as shower floor treatments, niche linings, and feature walls. There's a practical benefit too. The extra grout lines in mosaic installations improve slip resistance on wet surfaces, adding a safety advantage to the design.

Our Testimonials
Our Bathroom Tile Installation Process

When San Antonio homeowners call C&S Remodeling for bathroom tile installation, we manage the entire project from first design meeting through final cleanup. Our process runs on clear communication and zero surprises. You should know exactly what's happening in your home at every stage.

‍

Design Consultation and Material Selection. We start with an in-home consultation where we look at your current bathroom, talk through your goals, and walk through material options together. We'll help you balance looks, durability, and budget, with guidance on which tile types perform best in your specific application. Want to experiment before committing? Our online bathroom tile visualizer lets you upload a photo of your actual space and preview tile selections in real time.

‍

3D Rendering and Project Planning. Every C&S Remodeling bathroom tile project includes complimentary 3D renderings. You'll see your finished bathroom in photorealistic detail before a single tile is ordered. This catches design issues early and confirms the final look matches what you have in mind. We also provide a detailed project scope and upfront estimate at this stage, so there are no cost surprises before work begins.

‍

Surface Preparation and Old Tile Removal. Our crew removes existing tiles safely, inspects the substrate for damage, and prepares the surface for new installation. Good prep is the foundation of long-lasting tile. We check for moisture damage, level uneven surfaces, and apply waterproofing membrane in wet areas like showers and tub surrounds to keep water from reaching the wall cavity.

‍

Tile Installation. We lay floor and wall tiles with careful attention to alignment, spacing, and pattern consistency. Every cut is measured twice and made with professional tile saws for clean edges around fixtures, outlets, and corners. Our installers work methodically so grout lines stay consistent across the full surface, even in herringbone or basketweave layouts.

‍

Grouting, Sealing, and Final Inspection. Once tiles are set, we apply grout in the right color and finish, seal natural stone and grout lines where needed, and do a thorough final walk-through. We go through the finished bathroom with you to confirm every detail looks right before we call the job done.

Expert Bathroom Tilework Craftsmanship

The difference between a professional bathroom tile installation and an amateur one shows up in details most people don't notice until something goes wrong. Grout lines that drift off-center across a large wall. Tiles that sit unevenly because the substrate wasn't leveled right. Cuts around fixtures that leave visible gaps. C&S Remodeling prevents these problems through disciplined installation practices built over years of bathroom remodeling across San Antonio.

Our tile installers bring that same discipline to every step. Layout starts with careful measurement and dry-fitting to confirm the pattern breaks symmetrically and no row ends with an awkwardly thin sliver of tile. We use laser levels and consistent spacers to hold alignment across large surfaces, and we cut with professional wet saws for clean, chip-free edges. The result is a finished surface that looks intentional from every angle.

C&S Remodeling is a family-owned company established in 2015, built on craftsmanship, honesty, and personal accountability. Scott brings a military and IT background that shows in the organization of every job site. Carol's design expertise makes sure the technical work serves the bigger aesthetic picture. When you hire C&S, you're working with people who take personal pride in the quality of their work — not a revolving crew of subcontractors.

Comprehensive Tile Installation Services For Your Bathroom Remodel

Our bathroom tile installation services in San Antonio cover every surface and application in your bathroom. Retiling a single shower or renovating the whole room — we handle projects at any scale with the same level of care. Here are the specific tile services we provide as part of our bathroom remodeling work.

Backsplashes


Our bathroom tilers in San Antonio specialize in installing stylish and protective tile backsplashes to enhance the look and functionality of your bathroom. These features protect your walls from splashes and moisture, adding stunning visual interest. The durable surface also protects from damage. When installing tile backsplashes, we precisely cut around fixtures and outlets to create a professionally finished appearance.

Backsplashes can improve a space in numerous ways, such as light-colored or reflective tiles, which make a room appear larger. A detailed backsplash can create a statement and a bold focal point, while other designs, like subway tiles, create a clean and classic look.

Tile Showers


We design and install elegant tile showers that combine durability with aesthetic appeal. Tile showers are an excellent way to modernize your shower and create a unique look. They can also stand up to decades of use, while being relatively simple to clean.

At C&S Remodeling, we begin by helping you choose the right tiles, selecting materials like glass or porcelain that resist moisture. If you prefer natural stone, we'll use professional sealing to maintain its quality over time. Our team can also recommend slip-resistant options for the floor. Typically, floor tiles will be smaller because extra grout lines create a better grip.

We can work with you to find complementary floor and wall tiles for your shower. Once you choose tiles, our bathroom tile installation contractors can strip the existing shower, prepare the wall area, and professionally place each tile for a gorgeous finish.

Tile Flooring


Your bathroom needs high-quality tile flooring options that are beautiful and easy to maintain. The high-moisture environment requires specially designed solutions. We'll help you find the right one for your space, whether you prefer large rectangular tiles or unique hexagonal shapes.

We use professional tools and techniques to create a perfectly flat surface and the ideal spacing and placement when laying the tiles. This extra attention to detail results in a longer-lasting floor that resists cracking. We can lay tiles in your preferred pattern, from herringbone to basketweave or other custom designs. Our bathroom tile contractors can also create the perfect fit around fixtures like toilets and bathtubs.

Shower And Tub Surrounds


Installing tiles around showers and bathtubs enhances aesthetics and protects walls from moisture. If you want a shower or tub surround, we can design an option that fits the specific dimensions perfectly. Our team can create decorative accents like tile bands to add visual interest. If you want storage nooks inside the shower, we can plan tile design around these features for a seamless appearance. You can even choose a different tile design to make these elements stand out.

Before the new installation, we remove the old tile and replace the drywall or backing as needed. Then, we will waterproof the area before we start tiling. During the tiling process, our team expertly levels and spaces tiles. We also create detailed cuts around tub spouts, knobs and shower heads.

Accent Walls


Creating feature walls with decorative tiles can add visual interest and style to your bathroom. At C&S Remodeling, we collaborate with you to design statement-making feature walls that transform ordinary bathrooms into designer showcases with bathroom tile installation in San Antonio.

We will walk through options like brightly colored, textured, patterned, or three-dimensional tiles to add depth and tactile interest to your bathroom walls. Our team will help you find the best location for an accent wall, such as behind the vanity or inside the shower. Our expert installations make these designs pop with clean lines and even spacing.

Frequently Asked Questions
How Long Does A Bathroom Tile Installation Take?


Three to seven days for most projects. A straightforward floor retile in a standard bathroom wraps up in a few days, while a full renovation with custom shower tilework, new floors, and accent features runs closer to a week. We give you a clear timeline during planning and keep you updated as work progresses.

What Type Of Tile Is Best For Bathroom Showers?


Porcelain. Its low water absorption rate makes it highly resistant to moisture damage and mold. Glass tile is another strong shower option, especially for accent bands and niches, because it's completely non-porous. For shower floors, smaller tiles or mosaics are the better call; the extra grout lines provide grip on wet surfaces.

Do You Handle The Full Bathroom Remodel Or Just The Tilework?


Yes, we do both. C&S Remodeling is a full-service design-build remodeler — we handle plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, and tilework all under one roof. If you only need tile, we're happy to take that on as a standalone project. Either way, you get fewer contractors in your home, faster timelines, and one point of contact.

Can I See What My Bathroom Will Look Like Before The Tile Is Installed?


Yes. Every project includes complimentary 3D renderings that show your finished bathroom with your actual tile picks. You can also use our online bathroom tile visualizer to upload a photo of your current space and preview different options in real time before your consultation.

Do You Serve Areas Outside San Antonio?


We serve the entire San Antonio metro area and surrounding Hill Country communities: Alamo Heights, Boerne, Bulverde, Fair Oaks Ranch, Helotes, New Braunfels, Shavano Park, and Timberwood Park.

How To Choose, Install, And Replace Your Bathroom Vanities & Cabinets

A bathroom vanity brings your sink, countertop, storage, and plumbing connections together in a single fixture, which makes it the hardest-working piece in the room. It is also one of the most visible, so a dated or damaged vanity drags down an otherwise beautiful bathroom. You might need a straightforward replacement, or a fully custom piece built for an awkward space. Either way, C&S Remodeling manages the entire project for you.

Our team measures your space, confirms clearances for doors and drawers, and checks the condition of the plumbing behind the wall before any work begins. On installation day we disconnect and remove the existing unit, secure the new base level and square, connect the sink and faucet, seal the countertop, and leave the room clean and ready to use. Because C&S is a design-build remodeler with plumbing handled in-house, there's no juggling separate contractors, and no finger-pointing if something unexpected turns up behind the old cabinet.

Standard vanity height runs 32 to 36 inches, but custom work means you are not stuck with standard. Taller homeowners, accessible designs, and kids' bathrooms all have different comfort points, and we build to yours. We settle every detail with you before we build; the vanity that arrives is exactly the one you approved.

Designs We Offer For Bathroom Vanity Installation Services

These are the vanity styles we design and install most often:

‍

Freestanding vanities. The classic choice. A freestanding vanity sits on the floor like a piece of furniture and offers the most storage per square foot.
Floating vanities. Wall-mounted with open space beneath. Smaller bathrooms feel bigger, and mopping gets easier.
Double-sink vanities. Two sinks, one countertop, and enough drawer space for both of you. The go-to for primary bathrooms and busy mornings.
Single-sink vanities. Sized for guest baths, powder rooms, and narrow layouts.
Furniture-style vanities. Built with the detail of a fine dresser or sideboard, these bring warmth and character to traditional bathrooms.
Vessel sink vanities. A raised basin on a lower counter creates a striking focal point and frees up counter depth.
Corner vanities. Purpose-built for tight layouts where a standard cabinet won't fit.
Fully custom vanities. When no standard configuration works, we design and build a custom vanity in San Antonio to your exact dimensions, finishes, and storage plan.

Not sure which direction suits your bathroom? That's what the design consultation is for. We'll show you options in your actual layout before anything gets built.

Our designers work with you on the size, layout, and every element in between, right down to the hardware finish on the drawer pulls. The finish sets the tone for the whole room. Choose the warmth of natural wood, the sleek depth of high-gloss lacquer, or painted cabinetry in a color matched to your tile and countertops. Because we build to your bathroom's exact dimensions, there are no filler strips or dead corners; every inch does a job.

Increased Home Value

Bathrooms sell houses. A well-designed custom vanity distinguishes your home from every builder-grade bathroom on the block and gives future buyers something to remember.

Store-bought vanities come in fixed sizes and finishes, which means compromising on fit, storage, or style. Understanding Cabinet Construction And Materials

Not all cabinets are created equal. Understanding construction methods and materials helps you make informed decisions about quality and value.

Cabinet Box Construction

‍

Plywood Construction (Recommended)

The gold standard for cabinet boxes. Plywood is made from thin layers of wood veneer glued together, creating a strong, stable material that resists warping and holds screws securely. Our custom cabinets feature plywood box construction for lasting durability.

‍

Particle Board

Made from wood particles bonded with resin, particle board is less expensive but more susceptible to moisture damage and doesn't hold hardware as well over time. Common in builder-grade and budget cabinets.

‍

MDF (Medium-Density Fiberboard)

Engineered wood that's denser and smoother than particle board. MDF is excellent for painted doors due to its smooth surface, but performs poorly when exposed to moisture.

Door Materials

‍

Solid Wood

Premium choice for natural beauty and durability. Solid wood doors can be stained to showcase grain patterns or painted for a smooth finish. Species options include maple, cherry, oak, hickory, and more, each with unique characteristics.

‍

MDF with Wood Veneer

MDF core with a thin layer of real wood veneer offers the look of solid wood at a lower price point. An excellent choice for stained finishes when budget is a consideration.

‍

Thermofoil

Vinyl film applied over MDF creates a smooth, easy-clean surface at a budget-friendly price. Best for painted looks, though it can peel over time with heat exposure near ovens and dishwashers.

Custom Kitchen Countertops In San Antonio

C&S Remodeling includes custom kitchen countertops in larger kitchen remodeling projects in San Antonio. We're veteran-owned, woman-owned, and family-run, serving homeowners since 2015. We don't take standalone countertop replacement jobs. Our team helps you choose surfaces that work with your cabinets, layout, and overall remodeling budget, with options including granite, quartz, marble, and quartzite. Kitchen remodeling projects include complimentary 3D renderings so you can review countertop choices alongside your cabinets, flooring, and lighting before construction.

CONTACT US
About Our Kitchen Countertop Installation Experts

C&S Remodeling includes countertop selection and installation as part of larger kitchen remodels throughout San Antonio. Our team specializes in granite, quartz, marble, and other premium surfaces, ensuring each kitchen countertop is crafted and installed precisely and carefully. Whether you want the durability of quartz, the look of marble, or the unique patterns of granite, at C&S Remodeling, our services meet your specific needs and style preferences.

See your new kitchen countertops before work even begins with our AI Visualizer Tool. Explore different counter top styles and colors!

Countertop Materials We Install
Granite Countertops


Granite is the most popular kitchen countertop material in San Antonio for good reason. It's durable, heat-resistant, and every slab is one of a kind. Because granite is quarried from natural stone, no two countertops will look identical, which is part of the appeal for homeowners who want a kitchen that doesn't look like every other kitchen on the block. We help you pick from a wide range of color families (classic blacks and grays, or dramatic blues, golds, and reds), and we'll bring slab samples to your home so you can see how each one looks in your actual lighting before you commit.

Granite needs to be sealed periodically to keep it stain-resistant, and we'll walk you through the maintenance basics during the final review.

Marble Countertops


Marble is the look most clients picture when they think "luxury kitchen": soft veining, a cool surface, the kind of finish that ages into something with character. It's also the most demanding material on this list. Marble etches when it meets acidic foods like lemon juice or wine, and it stains more easily than granite or quartz. We're upfront about that during your consultation because marble is a great fit for some kitchens and the wrong choice for others. If you love the look but cook with citrus daily, we'll often steer you toward a quartz that mimics marble veining instead. Same aesthetic, none of the upkeep.

Other Surfaces — Butcher Block, Concrete, And Solid Surface


For clients who want something outside the stone family, we also install butcher block (warm, food-safe, needs oiling), concrete (custom-poured, industrial look, can be tinted or stamped), and solid surface options like Corian. We don't push these. Most kitchens we remodel land on granite or quartz, but if you're going for a specific aesthetic, we'll make it work.

Quartz Countertops


Quartz is our most-requested countertop material in San Antonio, especially for homeowners with kids, frequent dinner parties, or busy weeknights. Unlike granite, quartz is engineered (natural quartz crystals bonded with resin), so it's non-porous, stain-resistant, and never needs sealing. The pattern stays consistent slab to slab, which makes it easy to predict how the finished kitchen will look. Quartz also comes in finishes that mimic high-end marble without the maintenance, which is why we install so much of it in San Antonio remodels.

We work with all the major quartz brands and will help you compare warranties, finishes, and price tiers so you're not paying for a name when a comparable option costs less.

Quartzite Countertops


Quartzite is the material clients land on when they want the look of marble with the durability of granite. It's a natural stone (not the same as quartz) that's harder than granite, doesn't etch the way marble does, and shows the kind of dramatic veining that turns a countertop into the focal point of the kitchen. Pricing sits at the higher end, and supply varies by slab, so we'll help you check inventory before we lock in a design.

Kitchen Countertop Cost In San Antonio

Kitchen countertop pricing in San Antonio varies more than most homeowners expect, because the slab itself is only part of the cost. The biggest variables are square footage, material grade, edge profile complexity, cutout count (sinks, cooktops, faucets), and whether your existing layout needs structural work to accept the new surface. Countertops are priced within the scope of your larger kitchen remodel. C&S kitchen projects range from roughly $25,000 for a small kitchen to $85,000, depending on scope and size; this is the overall kitchen budget, not a countertop-only price.  We don't quote pricing without seeing your kitchen. After your in-home consultation, you'll get an itemized estimate that breaks down material, fabrication, removal of the old countertops, plumbing reconnection, and any add-on work, so you know what you're paying for line by line. Countertops are included as part of a larger kitchen project. Use our guide to plan your overall kitchen remodel budget.

Why Choose C&S Remodeling For Your Kitchen Countertops?
Veteran-Owned, Woman-Owned, Family-Run

C&S Remodeling was founded in 2015 by Scott and Carol. Scott brings a military and IT background, Carol brings the design eye, and both of them are personally involved in every project. We're one of the few veteran-owned and woman-owned remodeling companies in San Antonio, and we built the company on the belief that you should know exactly who's working in your kitchen and who to call when you have a question. No call centers, no project handoffs.

Design-Build, All Under One Roof

Countertops are one part of the larger kitchen projects C&S handles. Our design-build team plans the cabinets, surfaces, layout, plumbing, electrical work, and finishes together so countertop choices fit the complete remodel. We don't offer standalone countertop fabrication or replacement.

Complimentary 3D Renderings

Before installation, we produce a full 3D rendering of your new kitchen so you can see how your chosen countertop looks alongside your cabinets, backsplash, flooring, and lighting. You can swap materials, change edge profiles, and adjust colors in the rendering, not after installation when changes are expensive. Every kitchen remodeling project at C&S includes this rendering at no extra charge.

Honest Material Guidance

We'll tell you when a material is wrong for your kitchen. If you cook with citrus and want marble, we'll show you a quartz that nails the look without the maintenance. If you want the absolute best stain resistance, we'll point you to quartz over granite. Our job is to make sure you're happy with your countertops in five years, not just at the install walkthrough.

Our Countertop Installation Process

We've built our installation process around removing the surprises that derail most kitchen remodels in San Antonio. Here's exactly what to expect from your first call to the final walkthrough.

1. In-Home Consultation And Material Selection


We come to your home, look at your existing kitchen, and talk through what you're trying to accomplish, whether that's matching a recently updated cabinet color, opening up a tight galley layout, or finally fixing a counter that's been bothering you for years. We'll bring slab samples in the materials you're considering so you can see them under your kitchen's actual lighting. By the end of this visit, you'll have a clear sense of which material fits your budget, your habits, and the look you want.

2. Precise Measurement And 3D Rendering


Our team uses laser-precise measurements rather than tape-and-pencil to capture every cabinet, overhang, and seam location. Those measurements feed into a full 3D rendering of your new kitchen (countertops, cabinets, backsplash, and lighting) so you can review the design before fabrication starts. If something looks off in the rendering, we change it. Once you approve, we move to fabrication.

3. Fabrication And Installation


We disconnect plumbing and electrical, remove the existing countertops carefully to protect your cabinets and floors, and bring the new slabs in. Our installers level, scribe, and seam them with the kind of attention you'd expect from a craftsman who's about to be on this same job tomorrow. Sinks get re-mounted, faucets reinstalled, garbage disposals reconnected. You don't end up with a dish you can't run.

4. Final Walkthrough And Care Guidance


Before we leave, we walk through every edge, seam, and surface with you. We'll explain the maintenance routine for your specific material (how often to seal granite, how to clean quartz, what to keep off marble) and answer any final questions. If anything isn't right, we fix it before we pack up.

Frequently Asked Questions
How Long Does A Kitchen Countertop Installation Take In San Antonio?


Most kitchen countertop installations finish in one day once the slabs are fabricated and on site. Templating happens during the design phase, fabrication typically takes 7–14 business days depending on material availability, and installation itself is a single visit. You'll be without a working kitchen sink for roughly 24 hours on install day.

What's The Most Durable Countertop Material For A Busy Kitchen?


For a household that cooks daily, hosts often, or has young kids, quartz is usually the most forgiving material. It's non-porous, stain-resistant, and never needs sealing. Granite is a close second and gives you a more natural look, but it does need periodic sealing. Marble is beautiful but high-maintenance, and we steer most busy kitchens away from it.

Can You Replace Just The Countertops Without Remodeling The Whole Kitchen?


No. C&S includes countertops as part of larger kitchen remodeling projects and doesn't take countertop-only replacement jobs. For a standalone replacement, contact a countertop fabricator. For a larger kitchen remodel, schedule a consultation to discuss the full scope.

What's The Difference Between Quartz And Quartzite?


Quartz is engineered (crushed natural quartz crystals bonded with resin) and is fully non-porous. Quartzite is a natural stone, harder than granite, with dramatic veining that resembles marble. Quartz is more uniform and lower maintenance; quartzite is more dramatic and a step up in price. We'll show you side-by-side samples during your consultation.

Will My New Countertops Match My Existing Cabinets And Floors?


That's exactly what the 3D rendering is for. Before fabrication, we render your full kitchen (countertops, cabinets, flooring, lighting) so you can see how the colors and textures work together. If something clashes, we change the material selection at that stage, not after installation.

Do You Offer Financing For Kitchen Countertops?


We can connect you with financing options during your consultation. Most San Antonio homeowners we work with use a combination of cash and home equity, but for projects in the higher range, financing through one of our partners is straightforward.

Kitchen Tile Installation In San Antonio

Custom kitchen tile installation in San Antonio, designed and installed by a veteran- and woman-owned remodeling team. C&S Remodeling has been remodeling kitchens across San Antonio and the Hill Country since 2015. We handle every step in-house: design, demolition, surface prep, and tile installation. The finished work matches the renderings you approved on day one.

Statement backsplashes, accent walls, and new floor tile that holds up to a busy household: our kitchen tile installers bring military precision and design-first thinking to every project. We start with complimentary 3D renderings, walk you through tile, grout, and pattern options, and stay involved through final cleanup.

CONTACT US
About Our Kitchen Tile Services

A well-installed tile job is the difference between a kitchen you love for fifteen years and one you redo in five. Tile sits at every wear point in the room: water at the sink, grease behind the range, foot traffic at the island. The installation has to be dialed in or it shows quickly. Lippage, hollow spots, uneven grout lines, and misaligned patterns are the most common reasons homeowners call us to redo someone else's work.

We install kitchen tile across three applications: backsplashes, accent walls, and floors. The same in-house crew that handles your demolition, plumbing, electrical, and finish work also lays the tile. Because we control every phase of the remodel, your tile installer isn't waiting on a subcontractor to finish before they can start, and you're not coordinating four trades yourself. Most kitchen tile jobs in San Antonio finish in three to seven working days once we mobilize, depending on square footage and pattern complexity.

You'll see the layout before we cut a single tile. We dry-lay the first row, walk you through grout color options against your cabinets and countertops, and confirm the pattern direction in person. That extra hour up front prevents the most common surprise homeowners face on tile projects: "I didn't realize it would look like that."

Different Types Of Kitchen Tilework
Custom Backsplash

The backsplash is the most photographed surface in any kitchen remodel. It sits at eye level, catches the light from your under-cabinet fixtures, and ties together the cabinets, countertop, and hood. We install kitchen backsplashes in San Antonio using ceramic, porcelain, glass, natural stone, and handmade tile, and we have layouts ready for whatever direction you want to go.

‍

Subway tile in standard or elongated sizes for a clean look that pairs with shaker or flat-panel cabinets. We can lay it straight stack, offset, herringbone, or vertical depending on the ceiling height and visual weight you're after.

‍

Mosaic and patterned tile for kitchens where the backsplash carries the personality of the room. Penny rounds, fish-scale, hexagon, encaustic-look porcelain, or decorative centerpieces above the range.

‍

Natural stone including marble, travertine, and slate when you want texture and depth. We seal stone properly and walk you through the maintenance trade-offs before installation, because not every stone belongs behind a stove.

‍

Glass and metal accents for transitional and contemporary kitchens, usually as part of a larger ceramic or porcelain field rather than the entire surface.

‍

We carry the backsplash up to the underside of the cabinets as standard, and we can take it to the ceiling on the range wall for a high-impact focal point. Outlets are cut clean, plug colors are matched to the tile, and finishing trims (Schluter, bullnose, pencil rail) are selected to suit the style. Nothing left raw or improvised.

Tile Wall Designs

Tile isn't just for the wall behind the range. Full accent walls have become one of the most-requested features in San Antonio kitchen remodels over the last two years, especially in open-concept floor plans where the kitchen is visible from the living area.

‍

We install full-height accent walls behind the range, on the rear of an island, or as a feature wall in a banquette or breakfast nook. Common applications include:

‍

Floor-to-ceiling range walls in vertical-stack subway, fluted ceramic, or zellige to draw the eye up and make a tall ceiling feel intentional.
Island back panels finished in the same tile as the backsplash for a cohesive look from any angle in an open kitchen.
Breakfast-nook accent walls in handmade or textured tile to soften a dining banquette and define the space without a wall partition.

‍

Wall tile gets cut and finished differently than backsplash work. Corners, transitions to drywall, and reveals around windows or open shelving need to be planned before tile leaves the box. We map every cut on the layout sketch you approve, so you'll know exactly where the cut tiles fall and how the pattern resolves at the edges.

Kitchen Tile Flooring

Kitchen floors take more abuse than any other surface in your home: dropped pans, spilled liquid, rolling stools, dog claws, and the constant foot traffic between the fridge, sink, and range triangle. Tile is the most durable option for the way San Antonio families actually use their kitchens, and it stays cool underfoot during the long Hill Country summers.

‍

We install kitchen floor tile in three primary materials:

‍

Porcelain for high-traffic kitchens. Through-body porcelain hides chips and scratches, resists staining, and handles temperature swings without cracking. Large-format porcelain (12"×24" and up) is our most-installed kitchen floor material and the easiest to keep clean.
Ceramic when budget matters and the kitchen sees moderate traffic. Glazed ceramic gives you nearly the same visual range as porcelain at a lower per-square-foot cost.
Natural stone (travertine, slate, and limestone) when you want warmth and texture and you're committed to sealing the floor on schedule. We walk through the maintenance reality before you sign off.

‍

Every kitchen floor we install starts with a flatness check on the subfloor. If the substrate isn't within ANSI A108 tolerance for the tile size, we self-level before laying a single sheet of underlayment. Large-format tile lippage is one of the most common callbacks in this industry, and almost every case traces back to subfloor prep that got skipped.

‍

We lay floors in straight, offset, herringbone, or diagonal patterns. The tile can run under the toe-kick of new cabinets or stop at the cabinet face. Your call, and the answer affects the order of operations on a full kitchen remodel.

CONTACT US
Tile Materials We Install

The tile material drives almost every other decision on a kitchen project: pattern options, grout choice, sealing schedule, even how the room feels underfoot in winter. Here's a quick reference for the materials we install most often in San Antonio kitchens:

Porcelain


Dense and low water absorption. Best for floors and high-moisture backsplashes. Available in styles that mimic marble, concrete, or wood at a fraction of the upkeep.

Natural Stone


Marble, travertine, slate, and limestone bring depth and one-of-a-kind veining. Requires periodic sealing; we'll set the schedule with you and recommend products that work in the San Antonio climate.

Handmade And Zellige


Slight color and dimensional variation that gives a backsplash genuine character. We let clients know up front that "imperfection" is the point. Uniform tiles are the wrong call here.

Ceramic


Lighter and easier to cut than porcelain. Good fit for backsplashes and accent walls where heavy wear isn't a concern. Wider color and pattern range than porcelain on the budget end.

Glass


Reflective and easy to clean. Great for accent strips and contemporary kitchens. Cuts and finishes need to be planned carefully because glass shows every imperfection along an edge.

Mosaic And Decorative


Pre-mounted sheets in penny round, hex, fish-scale, herringbone, and custom patterns. Useful for niches, listellos, and small accent zones.

Our Kitchen Tilework Process

Kitchen tilework is part design decision, part technical install. The projects that go smoothly are the ones where both halves get the time they deserve before tools come out. Here's how we run a kitchen tile project from first call to final walkthrough:

1. Free In-Home Consultation


We measure the work area, talk through your goals, and review any inspiration photos or designs you've already saved. If your tile project is part of a larger kitchen remodel, we scope the whole job in this visit.

2. Design And 3D Rendering


Carol or one of our designers builds a 3D rendering of the finished space, included free on every C&S project. You see the tile, grout color, pattern, and surrounding finishes together before any material is ordered.

3. Material Selection.


We help you select tile, grout, and trim from local San Antonio suppliers. You can visit showrooms with us or work from samples we bring to your home, whichever fits your schedule.

4. Demolition And Substrate Prep


Existing tile, drywall, or subflooring comes out, and we level and waterproof the substrate to the tile manufacturer's spec. This is the step homeowners can't see in a finished photo, but it's the step that determines whether your tile is still flat in ten years.

5. Tile Installation


We dry-lay the first row, confirm the layout with you, then install. You'll see daily progress photos if you're not on-site.

6. Grouting And Sealing


Grout color is finalized against the installed tile (lighting changes everything), then we seal natural stone and finish trim work.

7. Final Walkthrough


We walk the finished room with you, make any punch-list adjustments, and hand off cleaning and maintenance instructions. Project closeout includes warranty paperwork and care guides for your specific tile and grout combination.

Frequently Asked Questions
How Much Does Kitchen Tile Installation Cost In San Antonio?


Kitchen tile pricing depends on three things: tile material, square footage, and pattern complexity. As a general benchmark for the San Antonio market, expect $4–$15 per square foot for materials and $5–$12 per square foot for installation, with intricate patterns (herringbone, mosaic, custom layouts) sitting at the higher end. We provide a fixed-price estimate after the in-home consultation so there are no surprises mid-project.

How Long Does A Kitchen Tile Project Take?


Most kitchen tile-only projects finish in 3 to 7 working days from demolition to final grout. Backsplash-only jobs are typically 2 to 4 days. Floor installations run 4 to 7 days because of substrate prep and curing time. If your tile work is part of a full kitchen remodel, the tile timeline integrates into the overall project schedule.

What's The Difference Between Porcelain And Ceramic For A Kitchen?


Porcelain is denser, absorbs less water, and resists chips and stains better. That makes it the go-to choice for kitchen floors and any backsplash near a sink or range. Ceramic costs less and comes in a wider style range on the budget end, and it works well for accent walls or backsplashes in lower-moisture areas. We'll recommend the right one based on where the tile is going and how much wear it'll see.

Do I Need To Seal My Kitchen Tile?


Glazed ceramic and porcelain don't need sealing; the glaze is the seal. Natural stone (marble, travertine, slate, limestone) and unglazed tiles do need to be sealed, typically every 1–3 years depending on the stone. Grout almost always benefits from sealing regardless of the tile choice. We use a penetrating sealer on grout lines as part of project closeout.

Can You Install Tile Over Existing Tile?


In some cases, yes. But it's usually not the best call for a kitchen. Floor heights change at every transition, cabinet kicks no longer line up, and any cracks or hollow spots in the original install will telegraph through to the new tile. We almost always recommend removing old tile to the substrate, checking the subfloor, and starting clean. We'll tell you if your project is one of the rare cases where overlay is the right move.

Do You Offer Free Estimates?


Yes. The initial consultation, measurement, and project estimate are free, and the 3D rendering is included on every C&S project at no cost. There's no pressure to commit during the visit; we want you confident in the decision before any work starts.

Are You Licensed And Insured?


Yes. C&S Remodeling is licensed and insured to operate in San Antonio and the surrounding Hill Country counties. We carry general liability and workers' comp on our crews, and we provide certificates of insurance on request before the project starts.

What To Expect: Whole Home Remodel Timeline
Phase 1: Design & Planning (4-8 Weeks)

We begin with in-depth consultations to understand your vision, lifestyle, and budget. Our team creates detailed plans, 3D renderings, and material selections. This phase includes permit applications and contractor scheduling. Taking time here prevents costly changes during construction.

Phase 2: Demolition & Structural Work (2-4 Weeks)

Selective demolition removes outdated elements while preserving what stays. Any structural modifications—wall removals, beam installations, foundation work—happen during this phase. We also address hidden issues like outdated wiring or plumbing discovered during demo.

Phase 3: Rough-In Work (3-6 Weeks)

Behind-the-walls work includes electrical rewiring, plumbing relocations, HVAC modifications, and insulation upgrades. Smart home infrastructure is installed during this phase. Inspections verify code compliance before walls close.

Phase 4: Finishing Work (6-12 Weeks)

The transformation becomes visible: drywall, trim, cabinetry, flooring, tile, paint, fixtures, and appliances. This phase takes the most time because each room moves through multiple trades in sequence.

Phase 5: Final Details (1-2 Weeks)

Touch-ups, final inspections, hardware installation, cleaning, and quality walkthrough. We don't consider a project complete until you're delighted with every detail.

Total Timeline: 4-8 Months

Most comprehensive whole-home renovations in San Antonio take 4-8 months from design through completion. Your project manager provides a detailed schedule during planning so you can make appropriate living arrangements.

Frequently Asked Questions About Whole Home Remodeling
Can I Live In My Home During A Whole-House Renovation?


It depends on the scope. Minor renovations may allow you to stay by working room-by-room. Comprehensive renovations that affect multiple systems simultaneously typically require temporary housing for 2-4 months. We'll discuss this during planning and help you make appropriate arrangements.

Do I Need Permits For A Whole Home Remodel?


Yes. San Antonio requires permits for structural changes, electrical work, plumbing modifications, and HVAC updates. We handle all permit applications and inspections as part of our full-service approach, ensuring your renovation meets code and is properly documented for future resale.

How Do You Protect Areas Not Being Renovated?


We install plastic barriers, floor protection, and air filtration systems to contain dust and debris. Areas completed early receive protective coverings until the entire project finishes. Our crews clean daily to maintain a safe, organized job site.

What's The Return On Investment For A Whole Home Remodel?


While ROI varies by project, comprehensive renovations in San Antonio typically recoup 50-70% of investment at resale. More importantly, you'll enjoy a home customized to your needs for years before any potential sale. The daily quality-of-life improvement often outweighs financial calculations.

Can You Work With My Existing Floor Plan Or Do I Need An Architect?


Our design-build approach includes experienced designers who can optimize your existing floor plan without hiring a separate architect for most projects. For major structural changes or additions, we collaborate with licensed architects and include that coordination in our services.

What If We Discover Hidden Problems During Renovation?


It happens—older homes especially may have hidden wiring issues, plumbing problems, or structural concerns not visible until demolition. We maintain contingency allowances in budgets and communicate immediately when discoveries occur, presenting options before proceeding.

3D Rendering FAQ
What Are 3D Renders?


3D renders or 3D rendering is the process of creating a digital, three-dimensional image or video of a space. When an area is 3D-rendered you can visualize a potential remodel before construction begins.

How Much Do 3D Renderings Cost?


At C&S Remodeling 3D renderings are included as part of the remodeling package. However, they are also available as a standalone service without committing to a remodel if you have a future project in mind. Prices vary based on the scope of the project (e.g., kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, or whole home remodeling) and how soon you need the rendering.

What Is The Turnaround Time For A 3D Rendering?


The turnaround time for a 3D rendering typically ranges from 24 hours to 14 business days, depending on the complexity and scope of the project. Factors such as design intricacy, revisions, and project size can influence the delivery time.

How Many 3D-Rendered Revisions Are Included?


We offer up to 5 small revisions and 2 large revisions for free if requested within 30 days of delivering the initial results. Additional revisions or requests made after the 30-day period will incur extra costs.

How Accurate Is The Final Project Compared To The 3D Rendering?


The final project is highly accurate compared to the 3D rendering, as we use the renderings as a detailed blueprint throughout the construction process. This ensures that the finished remodel closely aligns with the original design, allowing for minimal deviations and a precise execution of your vision.

What Is The Difference Between Regular 3D Renderings & Architectural Renderings?


Architectural floor plans are technical drawings focused on the precise layout and structure of a building, including measurements and compliance with regulations. In contrast, regular 3D renderings are visual representations that focus on aesthetics, showing how a space will look with materials, lighting, and furniture. While floor plans guide construction, 3D renderings provide a realistic view for design decisions and presentations.

We handle design, construction, plumbing, and electrical as one coordinated project. Complimentary 3D renderings let you see the proposed space before work begins.
