Our Home Addition Services

Room additions can take many forms, but the right plan starts with the way your household needs to use the space. Some projects add a single focused room. Others rework part of the existing floor plan so the new square footage improves the whole home instead of creating an isolated wing.

C&S Remodeling plans home additions around those everyday needs. We start with the available footprint and the path people will take through the new layout. Privacy, daylight, and storage come next, along with the relationship between the addition and the rooms beside it. Exterior proportions and finish transitions matter too; the addition has to work from the street as well as from the inside.

Our design-build approach keeps those decisions connected. The people discussing the layout also understand what it will take to build, wire, plumb, and finish the space. Complimentary 3D rendering help you compare options and make selections with a clearer picture of the finished addition.

Bedroom Addition


An extra bedroom can support a growing household, frequent guests, or a family member who needs more privacy. Furniture placement comes first. From there, we plan closets, windows, and the connection to a nearby bathroom or hallway so the room feels like part of the original layout.

Kitchen Additions And Expansions


When the existing kitchen footprint can't support better flow, more storage, or the gathering space a family wants, expanding outward may be the practical answer. The added square footage can make room for an island, pantry, dining area, or a less crowded work triangle. Because C&S also handles kitchen remodeling, we can plan the expansion and the interior kitchen as one project.

Sunrooms And Flexible-Use Rooms


A bright room can serve as a reading space, hobby room, playroom, studio, or relaxed place to host friends. Orientation, shade, windows, flooring, and heating or cooling choices all affect how comfortable the room will be throughout the year, so those decisions belong in the plan from the start.

Garages And Practical Storage Spaces


A garage addition can create protected parking, workshop room, household storage, or a better transition into the home. We plan it around vehicle clearance, doors, storage zones, and how the exterior mass relates to the house. A smaller dedicated storage or hobby structure can solve a different need without taking over a bedroom or living area.

Shed Addition


Create a dedicated space for storage, hobbies, woodworking, DIY projects, and more. Instead of cluttered, multi-use spaces inside your home, you can unlock a new, separate area.

Primary Suites And In-Law Suites


A private suite may combine a bedroom, bathroom, storage, and a small sitting area. For extended-family living, the priorities may also include a more independent entrance, convenient access through the home, and a layout that respects everyone's routines. We use the design phase to balance privacy with connection.

Family Rooms And Living Rooms


A larger gathering space can change how the entire home feels. We consider seating and media needs, then look at views and traffic between the kitchen, patio, and bedrooms. More square footage only helps when the room has a clear purpose.

Bathrooms


A bathroom addition may support a new bedroom suite, reduce competition in a busy household, or make the home's layout more practical for guests. Plumbing locations, storage, ventilation, privacy, and finish selections all need to work together. Our bathroom remodeling and design-build team coordinates those pieces with the surrounding construction.

Second-Story And Multi-Room Additions


Larger additions can create several rooms or add space where the lot offers limited room to expand outward. These projects call for especially careful planning around stairs, structure, rooflines, and the relationship between new and existing systems. C&S helps homeowners explore the layout in 3D before settling on the direction.

Tiny Home Designs

Our tiny home designs combine functionality and style, maximizing every square foot to create efficient, comfortable, and inviting living spaces.

Our Home Addition Process

A room addition affects more than one part of a home. The layout has to work with the exterior design. Plumbing and electrical decisions have to fit the plan, and the finish selections need to be ready when construction calls for them. C&S keeps those conversations together through its design-build process.

1. Free Consultation

We start with the reason you want more space. You'll walk us through the home, explain what isn't working, and share any ideas, photos, or priorities you already have. We use that conversation to understand the project goals and identify the questions the design needs to answer.

2. Existing-Home Review

The team studies the current floor plan and the likely connection points. We also look at the way the property can support an addition, then discuss neighboring rooms, circulation, natural light, exterior proportions, and the household's routines during construction.

3. Design And Complimentary 3D Renderings

C&S develops a layout that gives the new space a clear function while connecting it to the rest of the home. Complimentary 3D renderings make the proposal easier to evaluate. You can see room relationships, key finishes, and design details before the project moves ahead.

4. Scope And Selections

Once the direction is clear, the team works through the construction scope and the material choices that shape the final result. Early decisions about flooring, cabinetry, fixtures, lighting, windows, doors, and exterior finishes help reduce guesswork once work is underway.

5. Construction And Communication

C&S coordinates design, construction, plumbing, and electrical through one company. The team keeps the approved plan at the center of the work and communicates as the addition takes shape.

6. Final Walkthrough

At the end of the project, we review the completed space with you and address the final details. The finished addition should support the need that started the project and feel at home beside the rooms that were already there.

Designing An Addition That Belongs

An addition can meet every square-foot requirement and still feel wrong if the connection to the original house is awkward. Good design looks at the whole composition. The new room needs a comfortable path from the existing floor plan, sensible proportions, and a clear reason for where doors, windows, storage, and furniture will go.

‍

Exterior decisions matter just as much. Roof shape, window rhythm, siding, masonry, trim, and the overall mass of the addition affect how natural it looks from the street and yard. Exact material matches aren't always available, especially as homes age, so the plan may call for a deliberate transition rather than a forced imitation.

‍

Inside, continuity doesn't require every surface to match. Flooring may carry through, or a clear threshold may mark the change. Trim and ceiling heights can connect the spaces while lighting, paint, cabinetry, and hardware give the new room its own character.

‍

Complimentary 3D renderings give you a practical way to review those relationships. You'll be able to see how the addition sits beside the existing home and how key interior elements work together before committing to the final direction. That early clarity helps the finished space feel planned from the beginning.

When To Consider A Home Addition

An addition makes sense when you like your home and location but the existing footprint no longer supports the way you live. That tension often shows up gradually: a dining table becomes a work desk, guests sleep in a multipurpose room, storage spills into living areas, or a family member needs privacy the current floor plan can't provide.

‍

Common reasons San Antonio homeowners explore room additions include:

‍

A household is growing or changing. A new bedroom, bathroom, or suite can create room for children, guests, or extended family without forcing the household into a move.
The kitchen or living area is too tight. Expanding a high-use space can improve circulation, storage, seating, and the connection between cooking and gathering areas.
Work or hobbies need a dedicated room. A home office, studio, workshop, or flexible room can keep focused activities from taking over bedrooms and common areas.
The home needs a better long-term fit. A thoughtfully located suite or first-floor room can support new routines and give the family more options as needs change.
The property works, but the floor plan doesn't. If you value the neighborhood, yard, schools, and community, adding the right space may be preferable to starting over elsewhere.

More square footage isn't automatically the right answer. A better interior layout may solve the problem inside the current footprint. In other cases, the home simply needs more room. C&S can compare both directions during the consultation and help you decide which one fits the house and your priorities.

Home Addition Costs In San Antonio

The cost of a home addition in San Antonio depends on what you're adding and how the new construction connects to the existing house. A simple-looking room can involve foundation, structure, roofing, windows, insulation, electrical work, interior finishes, and changes to adjacent spaces. Add a kitchen or bathroom, and plumbing, cabinetry, fixtures, tile, and appliances may become part of the scope as well.

‍

The biggest cost drivers usually include:

‍

Size and room type. Bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, garages, and multi-room suites each call for different systems and finishes.
Connection to the existing home. Opening walls, tying into a roofline, extending utilities, and blending floor levels can affect the work required.
Structural and site conditions. The location of the addition, access to the work area, and the way the existing house is built all influence the plan.
Finish selections. Flooring, cabinetry, countertops, windows, doors, lighting, plumbing fixtures, and exterior materials can move a project in very different directions.
Work inside the existing footprint. An addition often changes the room beside it. Reworking a kitchen, hallway, bathroom, or living area may be necessary to make the expanded plan function well.

Use $250 to $400 per square foot as a starting range for a finished room addition. C&S then prices your project from its design and scope.

During the planning process, you'll be able to see how the layout and selections affect the project before construction begins. Schedule Your Free Consultation to start with the space, priorities, and investment level you have in mind.

Read the room addition cost guide for planning ranges by room type.

Plan Your San Antonio Room Addition

Start with what the home needs to do better. Who will use the new space? What will happen there every day, and which nearby rooms may need to change? Those answers are more useful at the beginning than a finish list or a guessed room size.

Bring those ideas to C&S Remodeling, even if they're still rough. Scott, Carol, and the design-build team can help you compare layouts, understand the decisions ahead, and shape a room addition that works with the home you already have. You'll also receive complimentary 3D renderings with the project so the plan is easier to understand before construction.

Smart Home Installation Services

We specialize in transforming your home into a smart, connected, and efficient living space. Our smart home installation services are designed to bring convenience, security, and energy savings to your fingertips by automating key home systems.

CONTACT US
What Aspects Of The Home Are Made Smart?

Whether you're looking to upgrade your lighting, secure your home with cutting-edge security systems, or manage energy consumption, we've got you covered. Contact C&S today for more info about the best home automation devices.

Our smart home installation services cover multiple areas, allowing you to control and automate various home systems for improved efficiency, security, and convenience. Each smart home system is designed to function independently or as part of a larger, integrated smart home network.

Smart Lighting Systems


Lighting is one of the most popular aspects of a smart home. With our smart lighting systems, you can manage your home’s lighting from anywhere, whether you’re at home or on the go. Here’s what you can do:

Remote Control: Adjust your lighting from your smartphone or tablet using an intuitive app. Whether you’re in another room or miles away, you can turn lights on or off with ease.
Scheduling: Set schedules to turn lights on or off at specific times, ensuring energy efficiency and enhancing home security by making it look like someone is home when you're not.
Voice Activation: Control your lights using voice commands via Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, or Apple HomeKit for hands-free convenience.
Automation: Automate lighting based on time of day, natural light levels, or occupancy to optimize comfort and energy usage.
Smart Home Security System


Home security is more critical than ever, and our smart security systems provide peace of mind by allowing you to monitor your home from anywhere. Our comprehensive security solutions include:

Smart Cameras: Keep an eye on your property in real-time with indoor and outdoor cameras. These cameras provide live video feeds and record footage for later viewing.
Motion Sensors: Receive instant notifications if motion is detected in or around your home, allowing you to take immediate action if needed.
Smart Locks: Forget about keys! Our smart lock systems allow keyless entry and remote access, so you can lock or unlock your doors from anywhere.
Mobile Apps: Control all aspects of your security system, including cameras, locks, and alarms, directly from your smartphone.
Smart Irrigation System


Keep your lawn and garden healthy while conserving water with smart irrigation systems. Our smart irrigation controller can:

Adjust Watering Schedules: Automatically adjust based on weather conditions and soil moisture levels, ensuring that your plants get the right amount of water without waste.
Remote Control: Start or stop your irrigation system from anywhere, using your smartphone or tablet.
Energy Monitoring System


Energy efficiency is a key concern for homeowners. With our home energy monitoring systems, you can:

Track Energy Use: Monitor real-time energy consumption in your home and see where your energy is being used most.
Make Informed Decisions: Identify opportunities to reduce consumption and save on utility bills by analyzing detailed usage reports.
Smart Integration: Control other smart devices, such as lights and appliances, to optimize energy use.
Smart Blinds & Shades


Smart window treatments, including smart blinds and smart shades, add comfort and energy efficiency by allowing you to:

Automated Schedules: Program blinds to open or close at specific times of the day, helping regulate temperature and natural light.
Remote Control: Adjust your blinds from anywhere using your phone or a voice assistant.
Smart Outlets & Plugs


With smart outlet plugs, any standard appliance can become part of your smart home network. These features include:

Remote Control: Turn devices on or off from your smartphone, no matter where you are.
Scheduling: Set schedules for appliances to run at specific times, helping you save energy and extend the life of your devices.
Smart Speakers & Voice Assistants


Smart speakers act as control hubs for your smart home. The best smart speakers and voice assistants allow you to:

Voice Commands: Control your home’s lights, thermostat, and other connected devices using simple voice commands.
Integration with Other Devices: Play music, check the weather, set reminders, and more - all hands-free.
Smart Thermostats & HVAC Controls


We offer the best smart thermostat systems to help you maintain a comfortable home environment while reducing energy costs. With personalized climate control, you can:

Remote Access: Adjust your home’s heating and cooling from your phone, ensuring your house is always at the perfect temperature when you arrive.
Custom Schedules: Set specific temperature settings based on your daily routine to save energy during times when you’re not home.
Energy Reports: Receive detailed energy usage reports to help you monitor and reduce utility costs.
Weather Integration: Smart thermostats can adjust settings based on local weather conditions, helping you maintain comfort and efficiency all year round.
Water Leak Detection


Water damage can be costly and destructive, but our smart water leak detection system provides a sensor to detect water leaks, helping you manage potential issues efficiently. This system includes several key features:

Real-Time Alerts: Notifying you immediately when a leak is detected, so you can address the issue before it causes significant damage.
Automatic Shutoff: Some systems can even shut off your home’s water supply automatically if a leak is detected, preventing further damage.
Smart Garage Door Opener


Our smart garage door openers add convenience and security. With this system, you can:

Remote Access: Open or close your garage door from anywhere using your smartphone.
Notifications: Receive alerts if the garage door is left open, giving you peace of mind when you’re away from home.
Smart Hubs & Control Panels


To streamline the management of all your smart devices, we install smart hubs and control panels that serve as the central command for your home. With these systems, you can:

Centralized Control: Manage all your connected devices from a single app or control panel, making it easier to keep track of everything.
Smart Automation: Create customized automation routines that connect various devices, such as turning on lights when the security system is armed.
Smart Doorbells


Keep your home secure with video-enabled smart doorbells. At C&S Remodeling we offer the best smart doorbell. Our smart video doorbell allows you to:

See Visitors Remotely: View live video feeds from your doorbell on your phone, so you can see who’s at your door even when you’re not home.
Two-Way Communication: Speak with visitors remotely, whether it's a delivery person or a friend dropping by.
Smart Locks


Our smart lock systems provide the ultimate in security and convenience. Features include:

Keyless Entry: Say goodbye to traditional keys with combination front door locks or smartphone-controlled entry.
Remote Access: Lock or unlock your doors remotely and receive alerts when someone enters your home.
Smart Smoke Detectors & CO2 Detectors


Keep your family safe with smart smoke and CO2 detectors. These devices:

Mobile Alerts: Send notifications to your phone if smoke or carbon monoxide is detected, so you can take action even when you’re away.
Integrated Safety: Sync with other smart devices to trigger lights or unlock doors in case of an emergency.
Smart Home Installation Process
1. Initial Consultation & Assessment

Our process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, goals, and preferences. We'll discuss your desired layout, style, and any specific features you want to include in your 3D remodeling image or video. This allows us to customize the design to your unique needs.

2. Design & Planning

After thoroughly understanding your goals and preferences, our expert team creates a custom smart home plan specifically designed for your lifestyle and home layout. This detailed plan outlines how each smart system will be integrated into your home, taking into account the best placement and functionality for every device.

By focusing on seamless smart systems integration, we ensure that all your devices work together harmoniously, providing a cohesive and efficient smart home experience.

3. Installation

Our certified installers handle all hardware setup with expertise and precision. Whether we're installing smart thermostats, lighting, or security systems, we ensure seamless smart systems integration, so all your devices are connected and work together effortlessly.

Once everything is set up, we make sure your smart home is fully functional and ready for use.

4. Testing & Demonstration

Once installation is complete, we conduct a thorough testing of each smart system to ensure everything is functioning correctly and efficiently. This step allows us to verify that all devices are integrated properly and communicate seamlessly within your smart home network.

In addition, we offer a hands-on demonstration, walking you through how to operate your new smart home features using the app or interface, ensuring you're comfortable and confident with managing your home's automation systems.

5. Post-Installation Support

After the installation, we remain fully committed to your smart home experience and won't leave you to navigate the system alone. We provide ongoing support and troubleshooting services, ensuring you can maximize the performance and benefits of your smart home systems.

Whether you're interested in adding new features or need assistance managing the existing devices, our dedicated team is always available to guide you and address any questions or concerns you may have.

‍

For those who prefer a more customized approach, we also offer à la carte options, allowing you to start small with individual features like smart thermostats or a smart home security system, providing flexibility to suit your budget and lifestyle.

Trusted Brands & Partners For Smart Home Solutions

At C&S Remodeling, we partner with some of the top brands in the smart home industry to deliver high-quality, reliable products and smart home solutions. Our collaborations with these industry leaders ensure that your home benefits from cutting-edge technology and user-friendly systems.

‍

‍

‍

User-Friendly Smart Home Apps For Seamless Control

At C&S Remodeling, we understand the importance of simple and intuitive control over your smart home systems. That’s why all of the smart home solutions we install come with easy-to-use mobile apps, allowing you to manage your home’s features from anywhere.

With these smart home apps, you can adjust your thermostat, monitor security cameras, control lighting, and track energy usage - all from your smartphone or tablet.

Whether using the Josh.ai Home Automation App for complete customization or the Elan Native App for a user-friendly interface, you’ll have full control over every aspect of your home’s automation, ensuring comfort, security, and energy efficiency with just a few taps.

Additional Considerations For Your Smart Home
Expandability

Our smart home systems are designed with future growth in mind. You can start with a basic setup and easily add new features as your needs evolve. Whether you want to enhance your home’s security, add more smart lighting, or integrate voice-activated assistants, expanding your system is simple and seamless.

Compatibility

We ensure that all our smart home installations are compatible with popular platforms like Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and Apple HomeKit. This flexibility allows you to choose the devices and voice assistants that work best for your lifestyle, ensuring that your smart home fits perfectly into your everyday routine.

Security

Your data privacy and home security are top priorities for us. We use smart home systems with robust encryption and advanced security protocols to protect against unauthorized access, ensuring that your smart home remains secure and your personal information is protected at all times.

The Perfect Time For Smart Home: During Your Remodel

C&S Remodeling offers something most smart home installers can't: the ability to integrate home automation during your kitchen, bathroom, or whole-home renovation. You can also plan smart-home features as part of a home addition. This approach delivers significant advantages for San Antonio homeowners.

01.
Hidden Wiring, Clean Installation

When walls are already open during renovation, we can run low-voltage wiring for smart systems without the need for surface-mounted conduits or wireless workarounds. The result is a cleaner installation, more reliable connections, and no visible evidence of the technology infrastructure.

02.
Cost Savings

Installing smart home wiring during construction or remodeling costs significantly less than retrofitting later. Running wire through open walls takes minutes; fishing wire through finished walls can take hours. These labor savings directly benefit your budget.

03.
Future-Proof Design

We install conduit and structured wiring that accommodates future technology upgrades. Even if you're not ready to install every smart feature today, we can prepare your walls for easy additions later—at a fraction of the cost of retrofitting.

04.
Coordinated Design

When your remodeling team and smart home team are the same company, design decisions are coordinated. Switch and outlet placements account for smart lighting plans. Cabinet and countertop layouts accommodate hidden charging stations. The result is seamless integration rather than afterthought additions.

05.
Single Point Of Contact

Coordinating between a general contractor and a smart home installer adds complexity and potential finger-pointing when issues arise. With C&S Remodeling handling both your renovation and smart home installation, you have one team responsible for the complete project.

DIY Smart Devices Vs. Professional Home Automation

Consumer smart devices from Amazon, Google, and Apple have made basic home automation accessible to everyone. But there's a significant difference between a collection of smart gadgets and a professionally integrated smart home system.

For homeowners who want a few smart conveniences—a smart speaker, a video doorbell, a smart thermostat—DIY devices work fine. But if you want your home to truly work together as a unified system, with reliable performance and professional support, a professionally designed and installed system delivers a fundamentally different experience.

Pros:

Lower upfront cost
Easy to start small and add over time
No professional installation required

Limited integration between devices

No support when things stop working together

Dedicated network prevents Wi-Fi issues
Professional support and troubleshooting

Smart Home Installation FAQ
Do I Need To Rewire My House For Smart Home Features?


Not necessarily. Many smart home features work wirelessly or with your existing wiring. However, for the most reliable, powerful systems—especially whole-home audio, lighting control, and networking—dedicated low-voltage wiring is recommended. If you're already remodeling, this is the ideal time to add smart home wiring at minimal additional cost.

Will My Smart Home Work If The Internet Goes Down?


Our systems are designed to function even without internet. Light switches still work manually, thermostats maintain their schedules, and security systems continue to operate. Internet is only required for remote access (controlling your home from away) and voice assistant features.

Can I Start Small And Add Features Later?


Absolutely. We can install the infrastructure—wiring, network backbone, and central controller—during your remodel, then add smart features over time as budget allows. This approach gives you the foundation for a smart home without the full investment upfront.

What Brands Do You Recommend?


We're certified installers for Josh.ai and Savant, both premium home automation platforms known for reliability and elegant interfaces. We also integrate with popular consumer brands like Sonos, Lutron, and Ring when appropriate for your needs and budget.

How Do I Control Everything?


Our systems offer multiple control options: smartphone apps for iOS and Android, wall-mounted touchscreens, voice control through Alexa, Google, or Josh.ai, and traditional switches for anyone who prefers them. You choose how you want to interact with your smart home.

What Happens If Something Breaks?


We provide ongoing support for all our smart home installations. Whether you need help with a new feature, troubleshooting an issue, or adding devices, our team is a phone call away. We also offer maintenance plans for homeowners who want regular system checkups.
